scripts.test:gateway: uv run --project services/gateway --directory services/gateway --locked python -m pytest
scripts.stack:logs: docker compose --env-file deploy/local/.env -f deploy/local/compose.yaml logs -f gateway
scripts.smoke:conversation: docker compose --env-file deploy/local/.env -f deploy/local/compose.yaml exec -T gateway python -m fennec_gateway.smoke
scripts.smoke:pause: docker compose --env-file deploy/local/.env -f deploy/local/compose.yaml exec -T gateway python -m fennec_gateway.smoke --pause
scripts.smoke:interruption: docker compose --env-file deploy/local/.env -f deploy/local/compose.yaml exec -T gateway python -m fennec_gateway.smoke --barge-in
